options.name: clickhouse

decision: How should scheduled jobs run exactly once while the API has six replicas?
context: Twelve jobs run on schedules, three of them every minute, and each can run up to 20 minutes and must not overlap itself. The API deploys 10 times a day on Kubernetes with six replicas, and the shared container image is 1.8 GB and takes 40 seconds to pull on a fresh node.

options.name: lease
options.text: Replicas elect a leader through a Kubernetes lease, and only the leader starts runs

options.name: cronjob
options.text: Kubernetes CronJobs that start a short-lived pod for each run, with overlap forbidden

options.name: singleton
options.text: One dedicated scheduler deployment with a single replica that executes the jobs itself

options.name: advisory
options.text: Every API replica runs the scheduler and takes a Postgres advisory lock before each run
